description:
Join us for the 2nd Annual Del Barrio Afro Latino Festival as we celebrate the beauty, joy, and resilience of Afro Latin culture on the shores of Spectacle Island!

Spend the day surrounded by island vibes, live entertainment, delicious food, beachside dominoes, lawn games, dancing, and the sounds of the African Diaspora across Latin America.

From Reggaetón, Kompa, Brazilian Funk, Merengue, Bachata, Salsa, Punta, and Cumbia, this is a celebration of the rhythms that connect us all.

Whether you’re coming to rep your flag, reconnect with your roots, or simply experience the magic of Afro Latinidad, this festival is for YOU.

🎟️ Scan the QR code or click the link in our bio to register today!

Registration is required, but free ferry wristbands will be distributed to the first 200 guests who check in on event day.
